user.title: Binary MoIP
user.description: Connect to your Binary MoIP controller.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the controller.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Uncheck a zone to hide it from Home Assistant; type a custom name to rename it. Blank keeps the controller's name.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Uncheck a source to hide it from the source list; type a custom name to rename it. Blank keeps the synthesized name.

spaces.title: Listening Spaces
spaces.description: Pick a Listening Space to edit, add a new one, or save & finish. Zones not in any space: {unassigned}.

space_new.title: Add a Listening Space
space_new.description: Name the new Listening Space (e.g. Pool & Outdoor).

space_edit.title: Edit Listening Space
space_edit.description: Rename {space}. Pick a Label to source membership from your areas (label → areas → zones) — or leave it blank and pick zones explicitly. A label takes over membership; the explicit list is ignored while a label is set. Volume levels are set later in the calibration tool.

data.name: Name
data.label: Membership label (optional)
data.zones: Zones (used only when no label is set)

calibration.title: Calibration reference
calibration.description: Optional: pick a pink-noise (or reference) track and the player to audition it on during calibration. Leave blank to calibrate with any source you're already playing.
